rv.q: That “Spelling Bee” has succeeded not only in maintaining but even amplifying its spontaneity despite the increased commercial stakes of a Broadway move reflects the freshness of this big-hearted little show.

In the long, exhausting reality show formerly known as life, which cannot be traversed with the aid of TiVo, there are peaks and there are valleys. Qualifying as traditional high points are weddings and children’s birthdays, career triumphs, the day you bought those jeans that actually flatter.
Here there was the possibility of something meaningful, which has been treated as a cartoon.

cn.t: Critics are largely charmed by this modest musical about awkward adolescence, praising its intact Off-Broadway charms and sweet vindication of nerdy misfits, though one finds it precious and lacking sting.
